item.title: Public agencies that guaranteed loans for opening local clinics and pharmacies – 3.5709 trillion won over five years (동네 병원·약국 개업에 보증 서준 공공기관… 5년간 3조5709억원)
item.description:
Public agencies that guaranteed loans for opening local clinics and pharmacies – 3.5709 trillion won over five years (동네 병원·약국 개업에 보증 서준 공공기관… 5년간 3조5709억원)

The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) has pointed out that a public agency, whose main role is to guarantee debts for companies with weak collateral, has provided trillions of won in guarantees for doctors and pharmacists opening clinics and pharmacies. (담보 능력이 약한 기업의 채무를 보증해주는 것이 주 업무인 공공기관이 의사·약사의 병원과 약국 개업에 수조 원어치 보증을 해준 것으로 드러나 감사원 지적을 받았다.)

According to a regular audit report on the Korea Credit Guarantee Fund (KODIT) released by the BAI on the 16th, KODIT has been operating a "Pre-Startup Fostering Guarantee (pre-startup guarantee)" program since 2014, claiming to support promising prospective startups with excellent technology and ideas. The amount guaranteed by KODIT under this program reached 4.1692 trillion won over the five years from 2021 to 2025. (감사원이 16일 공개한 신용보증기금 정기 감사 보고서에 따르면, 신보는 우수한 기술과 아이디어를 가진 예비 유망 창업 기업을 지원한다며 2014년부터 ‘예비 창업가 육성 보증(예비 창업 보증)’ 프로그램을 운영하고 있다. 신보가 이 프로그램에 따라 보증을 서준 금액은 2021~2025년 5년간 4조1692억원에 달한다.)

For example, if a recipient of the pre-startup guarantee pays a certain percentage of 1 billion won as a guarantee fee to KODIT, they can receive a 1 billion won loan from a commercial bank without collateral. This is because KODIT guarantees the repayment of this loan to the bank. (예를 들어, 예비 창업 보증의 혜택을 받는 사람은 10억원의 일정 비율에 해당하는 금액을 신보에 보증료로 내면, 담보가 없어도 시중은행에서 10억원 대출을 받을 수 있다. 신보가 은행에 이 대출금의 상환을 보증하기 때문이다.)

However, when the BAI checked who actually received guarantees through this program, it found that out of the 4.1692 trillion won in guarantees from 2021 to 2025, only 171.4 billion won, or 4.1%, was provided to people starting technology or knowledge-based businesses. (그런데 감사원이 이 프로그램을 통한 보증이 실제로 누구에게 제공됐는지를 확인해 보니, 2021~2025년 보증액 4조1692억원 가운데 단 4.1%인 1714억원만이 기술·지식 기업을 창업하는 사람에게 제공된 것이었다.)

The remaining 3.9978 trillion won (95.9%) was provided to professionals starting businesses, such as doctors, pharmacists, veterinarians, lawyers, certified public accountants, and tax accountants. The majority of this, 3.5709 trillion won (85.6%), went to medical professionals starting businesses, including doctors, pharmacists, oriental medicine doctors, dentists, and herbal medicine practitioners. The benefits of a program created to support tech startups have largely gone toward opening neighborhood clinics and pharmacies. (나머지 3조9978억원(95.9%)은 의사, 약사, 수의사, 변호사, 공인회계사, 세무사 등 전문직으로서 창업을 하는 사람들에게 제공됐는데, 대부분인 3조5709억원(85.6%)은 의사, 약사, 한의사, 치과의사, 한약사 등 의약 계열 전문직으로 창업을 하는 사람들에게 제공됐다. 기술 기업 창업을 돕겠다며 생긴 프로그램의 혜택 대부분이 동네 의원·약국 개업에 돌아간 것이다.)

There were also many cases where KODIT provided multiple guarantees to doctors and pharmacists who repeatedly opened and closed businesses. The Framework Act on Small and Medium Enterprises and its enforcement decree stipulate that closing an existing business and reopening the same type of business within three years does not constitute a startup. However, KODIT did not have a similar regulation in place, so it was issuing guarantees every time doctors or pharmacists opened a business. (개업과 폐업을 거듭하는 의사·약사에게 신보가 여러 차례 보증을 서준 경우도 다수 나왔다. 중소기업창업법과 시행령은 기존 사업을 폐업하고 3년 안에 같은 종류의 사업을 개업하는 경우는 창업에 해당하지 않는다고 규정하고 있다. 그러나 신보는 이 법령과 같은 규정을 만들어 놓지 않아, 의사·약사들이 개업할 때마다 보증을 서주고 있었다.)

When the BAI investigated 129 medical professionals who received pre-startup guarantee benefits while taking loans of over 1 billion won from financial institutions, 50 (38.8%) received these benefits after merely closing their existing clinics or pharmacies on paper, then remodeling, expanding, or relocating them. This was because KODIT’s standards treated all of these as "new business openings." (감사원이 금융기관에서 10억원 넘게 대출받으면서 예비 창업 보증 혜택을 받은 의약 계열 전문직 129명을 조사해 보니, 50명(38.8%)은 기존 의원·약국을 서류상으로만 폐업한 뒤 이를 리모델링하거나 확장, 이전하면서 예비 창업 보증 혜택을 받았다. 신보 기준으로는 모두 ‘개업’으로 처리되기 때문이다.)

Additionally, since KODIT had no limit on the number of guarantees per person, 360 doctors and others received the pre-startup guarantee multiple times. One pharmacist opened a pharmacy six times from 2005 to the end of last year, with three of those instances receiving KODIT guarantees. The total amount of loans guaranteed by KODIT for this pharmacist was 2.3 billion won. (또 신보가 한 사람당 보증을 해주는 횟수에 제한을 두고 있지 않아, 의사 등 360명이 예비 창업 보증을 여러 번 받은 것으로 나타났다. 한 약사는 2005년부터 지난해 말까지 약국을 6차례 열었는데, 그 가운데 3차례는 신보 보증을 받았다. 신보가 보증해 준 대출금은 총 23억원이었다.)

The BAI attributed this to the fact that guarantees for medical professionals opening businesses have a lower delinquency rate compared to guarantees for other industries, leading each KODIT branch to actively pursue these guarantees to achieve favorable performance evaluations. (감사원은 의약 계열 전문직 개업에 보증을 해주는 경우 다른 업종 보증에 비해 부실률이 낮고, 이로 인해 신보 각 영업점이 성과 평가에서 유리한 평가를 받으려고 의약 계열 전문직 개업을 보증해주는 데 적극적으로 나선 것이 원인이라고 봤다.)

The BAI stated, "The pre-startup guarantee, which should support prospective startups with excellent ideas and technology, is being operated as a system that funds the opening or reopening of clinics, hospitals, and pharmacies," and notified KODIT to improve the program and devise measures to prevent duplicate support. (감사원은 “우수 아이디어와 기술을 보유한 예비 창업자를 위해 지원돼야 할 예비 창업 보증이 병·의원 및 약국 창업 또는 재개업 자금을 지원하는 제도로 운용되고 있다”며 신보에 프로그램을 개선하고 중복 지원을 막는 방안을 마련하라고 통보했다.)

]]>

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Criticizes President Lee’s "YouTube Vote" – “Try a Vote on Dropping the Indictment of Lee Jae-myung” (한동훈, 李대통령 ‘유튜브 투표’ 비판 “공소 취소 투표해보라”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon Criticizes President Lee’s "YouTube Vote" – “Try a Vote on Dropping the Indictment of Lee Jae-myung” (한동훈, 李대통령 ‘유튜브 투표’ 비판 “공소 취소 투표해보라”)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon on the 16th criticized President Lee Jae-myung for conducting an impromptu YouTube vote on the 14th asking whether those owning so-called "ultra-high-priced" homes should bear higher ownership taxes, saying, "Go ahead and use the same method to put up a vote on the pros and cons of dropping the indictment of Lee Jae-myung." <<> Earlier, on the 14th, while presiding over a Cabinet meeting at the presidential office, President Lee was briefed on a "plan to gather public opinions on real estate policies" and said, "There is controversy over so-called 'prime single homes' – whether it's right to impose the same burden on ultra-high-priced homes worth over 10 billion won just because they are single, owner-occupied residences." He added, "Among the citizens watching the broadcast, let's try pressing button 1 or 2." <<> This was an impromptu vote targeting those watching the Cabinet meeting’s YouTube live stream. President Lee said, "If you think it's better to impose a heavier burden differentially on ultra-high-priced, owner-occupied single homes, press 1; if not, press 2." Viewers responded through the YouTube channel's chat window. President Lee also put the threshold for ultra-high-priced homes to a live vote, asking, "Press 1 for 1 billion won or more, 2 for 2 billion won or more, 3 for 3 billion won or more." <<> In response, Lawmaker Han posted on Facebook on the afternoon of the 16th saying, "President Lee put real estate tax policies to a vote among his supporters through YouTube comments during a Cabinet meeting." This implies that most viewers of the Cabinet meeting’s YouTube stream were likely supporters of President Lee. <<> Han then added, "I propose to President Lee: go ahead and use the same method to put a vote on the pros and cons of dropping the indictment of Lee Jae-myung on that YouTube channel." <<> The previous evening, Han also posted on Facebook calling President Lee's impromptu vote "appalling." Han said, "Real estate tax policies are not something to be decided by a spontaneous popularity vote among people watching the president’s YouTube channel," adding, "Asking a specific group in an unrepresentative comment section whether to impose more taxes on them evokes a modern-day people's court." <<> Han argued, "What the government should do is professional analysis and public deliberation," adding, "It should review who bears how much, what effects it has on the market and rents, and whether it aligns with tax principles, and then decide under government responsibility." He continued, "But President Lee shifted that responsibility by saying 'I asked the people watching my YouTube,'" and criticized, "Packaging reactions from his own channel's supporters as 'public opinion' is not communication." <<> Han also said, "The problem recognition is wrong," noting, "As demand concentrated on apartments priced at 1.5 billion won or less due to loan regulations, prices in districts like Seongbuk, Gangseo, Guro, and Gwanak in Seoul rose sharply in the first half of this year. The fiercest jeonse (lump-sum deposit) crisis is also not in the three affluent Gangnam districts but in the outskirts." He stated, "What the government should focus on is the collapse of the housing ladder for the middle and working classes, as apartment prices and jeonse costs surge simultaneously in Seoul's outer areas," and concluded, "Running a country is not a YouTube variety show." (이재명 대통령이 지난 14일 이른바 ‘초고가’ 주택을 보유한 사람이 보유세 등을 더 부담하도록 해야 하는지를 유튜브 즉석 투표에 부친 것을 두고 한동훈 무소속 의원은 16일 “똑같은 방식으로 ‘이재명 공소 취소 찬반 투표’를 부쳐 보라”고 비판했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "There Are Still Agency Heads Who Don't Know Their Work... I'm Warning You" (李대통령 “아직도 업무 모르는 기관장 있어...경고 드린다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "There Are Still Agency Heads Who Don't Know Their Work... I'm Warning You" (李대통령 “아직도 업무 모르는 기관장 있어...경고 드린다”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 16th, during the second day of consecutive government ministry work reports, "Yesterday, I saw that despite the criticisms and embarrassment during the previous work report, there are still agency heads who don't know what they're doing. This is unacceptable." He added, "I'm warning you in advance that you should at least understand your own duties, even if it means staying up all night." (이재명 대통령은 16일 이틀째 계속된 정부 부처 업무 보고에서 “어제 보니까 저번에 그렇게 업무 보고할 때 지적하고 좀 망신도 당하고 했음에도 불구하고, 아직도 자기가 하고 있는 일이 뭔지를 모르는 그런 기관장이 있더라. 있을 수 없는 일”이라며 “밤을 새워서라도 자기 업무는 최소한 파악하고 오라고 미리 경고 말씀드린다”고 했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during his closing comments at the work report held that morning, saying, "There are still agencies scheduled to report, so I think I need to say a few words in advance." (이 대통령은 이날 오전에 진행된 업무 보고 마무리 발언에서 “앞으로 업무 보고할 기관들이 있어서 미리 한 말씀 드려야 될 것 같다”며 이같이 말했다.)

The President's comments reference that during the work report in December of last year, some agency heads were strongly reprimanded by the President for not properly understanding their tasks, and similar cases appear to have been observed in this round of reports. (이 대통령의 언급은, 작년 12월 업무 보고에서 일부 기관장이 업무 파악이 제대로 되지 않았다는 이유로 대통령에게 강한 질책을 당했는데 이번 업무 보고에서도 비슷한 경우가 보인다는 것이다.)

President Lee stated, "Cases where they don't even grasp the basic outline are absolutely unacceptable. How can they enjoy all the benefits paid for by taxpayers' money while acting like this?" He added, "Is it acceptable to show no minimal interest in the duties entrusted by the law and the people?" (이 대통령은 “기본적인 개요조차 파악하지 못하고 그런 경우는 절대로 용납할 수 없다”며 “국민의 세금으로 누릴 건 다 누리면서 어떻게 그럴 수가 있나”라고 했다. 그러면서 “법률과 국민이 위임한 사무에 대해서 최소한의 관심도 없이 그러면 되겠나”라고도 했다.)

President Lee also said, "One hour of a national public official is worth 52 million hours. It's such an important matter that I wonder if they truly understand the gravity of it. I trust there will be no such people going forward." (이 대통령은 “국가 공직자의 한 시간은 5200만 시간의 가치가 있다”며 “얼마나 중요한 일인데 그 엄중함을 제대로 인식하지 못하는 것 아닌가 하는 그런 생각이 좀 들었다. 앞으로 그런 사람 없을 것으로 믿는다”고 했다.)

item.title: Cheongwadae Refutes Yoo Si-min: "Separation of Investigation and Prosecution Has Never Been Shaken" (靑, 유시민에 반박 “수사·기소 분리, 한번도 흔들린적 없다")
item.description:
Cheongwadae Refutes Yoo Si-min: "Separation of Investigation and Prosecution Has Never Been Shaken" (靑, 유시민에 반박 “수사·기소 분리, 한번도 흔들린적 없다")

The presidential office Cheongwadae stated on the 16th regarding the so-called 'prosecution reform' of the Lee Jae-myung administration that "the core value of prosecution reform, which is the separation of investigation and prosecution, has never been shaken." <<> In response to a question during a briefing about Yoo Si-min's remarks on YouTube the previous day, where he claimed that "President Lee does not want the separation of investigation and prosecution," Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong said, "We do not have a separate stance or respond separately to specific individuals' remarks." <<> Yoo, appearing on the YouTube channel 'Maebulsho' on the 15th, stated, "The reason prosecution reform has not been achieved for over a year is because the President does not want a complete separation of investigation and prosecution." Yoo also criticized President Lee's handling of state affairs, saying he is "making very misguided judgments" and "heading toward inevitable failure." <<> President Lee had expressed in press conferences and elsewhere that supplementary investigative powers should be allowed in exceptional circumstances but later stated he would leave the matter to the National Assembly's judgment. The Democratic Party of Korea has proposed an amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that completely abolishes the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers. However, as criticism and concerns poured in from various quarters that the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers would harm victims of sexual violence and socially vulnerable groups such as children, adolescents, the disabled, and the elderly, voices within the party have recently grown louder, arguing that "the complete abolition of supplementary investigative powers is unacceptable." (청와대는 16일 이재명 정부의 이른바 ‘검찰 개혁’과 관련해 “수사·기소 분리라는 검찰 개혁의 핵심 가치에 대해서는 한 번도 흔들린 적이 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party to Boycott Constitution Day Event... "No Progress in Assembly Formation Talks" (국민의힘, 제헌절 행사 불참…“원 구성 협상 진척 없어”)
item.description:
People Power Party to Boycott Constitution Day Event... "No Progress in Assembly Formation Talks" (국민의힘, 제헌절 행사 불참…“원 구성 협상 진척 없어”)

The People Power Party (PPP) has decided to boycott the National Assembly's Constitution Day event scheduled for the 17th. The move comes as a protest against the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), which has maintained an uncompromising stance in negotiations over the "second-half assembly formation" and the "Election Commission special counsel law," leveraging its majority seats. Although Constitution Day has been reinstated as a public holiday for the first time in 18 years, the parliamentary event to mark it is expected to be a "half-hearted ceremony" amid extreme confrontation between the ruling and opposition parties. <<> Floor leaders of both parties met at the National Assembly for talks on this day but failed to bridge their differences, parting ways after just over 10 minutes. PPP Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik told reporters immediately after the meeting, "There has been no progress, so today's talks have been concluded, but we will continue discussions. It's not yet at the stage of a complete breakdown," adding, "I believe it's difficult to participate in the Constitution Day event under these circumstances." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also indicated that he would skip the Constitution Day event and instead attend a rally at Olympic Park. <<> National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik had requested both parties to complete the assembly formation before Constitution Day, but negotiations remain at a standstill. The PPP insists that it must secure the chairmanship of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and that the opposition party should have the right to recommend candidates for the Election Commission special counsel bill. DPK Floor Leader Han Byeong-do told reporters earlier, "We are still in discussions, so nothing has been concluded," adding, "We will continue further consultations to normalize the assembly formation." <<> The 78th Constitution Day commemorative ceremony, hosted by the National Assembly, is scheduled to be held at 10 a.m. on the 17th in the Central Hall of the National Assembly. Attendees will include National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, Constitutional Court President Kim Sang-hwan, Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, along with other key state figures such as Board of Audit and Inspection Chair Kim Ho-cheol, former National Assembly speakers, and leaders of political parties except the PPP. <<> Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon is reportedly expected to boycott the Constitution Day event. Han also did not attend the first plenary session of the National Assembly's Budget and Accounts Special Committee held on this day to elect the ruling party's floor manager. The plenary session proceeded despite the PPP's boycott in protest of the DPK's unilateral assembly formation. A close aide to Han stated, "Although he was assigned to the Budget and Accounts Committee as an independent lawmaker, he judged it best not to attend as the negotiations on assembly formation between the ruling and opposition parties are not yet concluded." (국민의힘이 17일 열리는 국회 제헌절 행사에 불참하기로 했다. 더불어민주당이 다수 의석을 앞세워 ‘후반기 원(院) 구성’과 ‘선관위 특검법’ 협상 과정에서 양보 없는 태도를 이어가자, 이에 항의하는 차원에서 제헌절 행사에 참석하지 않기로 한 것이다. 18년 만에 제헌절이 다시 법정 공휴일이 됐지만, 이를 기념하는 국회 행사는 여야의 극한 대립으로 ‘반쪽 기념식’이 될 전망이다.)

item.title: Blue House opens NSC to discuss Korea-U.S. pending issues... Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha and Fair Trade Commission attend (靑 NSC 열어 한미 현안 논의... 강경화 대사·공정위까지 참석)
item.description:
Blue House opens NSC to discuss Korea-U.S. pending issues... Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha and Fair Trade Commission attend (靑 NSC 열어 한미 현안 논의... 강경화 대사·공정위까지 참석)

The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae announced on the 16th that it held a standing committee meeting of the National Security Council (NSC) chaired by National Security Director Suh Wook and discussed pending issues in Korea-U.S. trade and security sectors. (청와대는 16일 위성락 국가안보실장 주재로 국가안전보장회의(NSC) 상임회의를 개최하고 한미 통상·안보 분야 현안을 논의했다고 밝혔다.)

At the meeting, Director Suh emphasized, "In times of rising uncertainty in the external environment, we must well coordinate measures to protect national interests based on a shared understanding," and added, "Since Korea-U.S. relations combine trade and security, multiple ministries must cooperate organically to advance them to the next level," according to Cheong Wa Dae. (위 실장은 이날 회의에서 “대외 환경의 불확실성이 고조되는 시기일수록 공통된 인식을 바탕으로 국익을 지키기 위한 대처 방안을 잘 조정해야 한다”며 “한미관계는 통상과 안보가 결합한 만큼 한 단계 진전시키기 위해 여러 부처가 유기적으로 협력하여 대응해야 한다”고 말했다고 청와대는 전했다.)

In addition to regular standing committee members, Ambassador to the U.S. Kang Kyung-wha, who returned temporarily, also attended the meeting. Accordingly, it is believed that discussions on the 'Coupang issue,' which is affecting consultations in the Korea-U.S. trade and security sectors, took place. (이날 회의에는 기존 상임위원회 구성 위원 외에 일시 귀국한 강경화 주미 대사도 참석했다. 이에 따라 한미 통상·안보 분야 협의에 영향을 주고 있는 ‘쿠팡 문제’에 대한 논의가 이뤄졌을 것으로 보인다.)

Ambassador Kang told reporters at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building the previous day regarding the Coupang issue, "It’s an issue that lasts much longer than I thought." Officials from the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, and the Fair Trade Commission also participated in the meeting. (강 대사는 전날 외교부 청사에서 기자들과 만나 쿠팡 문제에 대해 “제가 생각했던 것보다는 훨씬 오래 가는 이슈”라고 말했다. 재정경제부, 산업통상부, 공정거래위원회 관계자들도 회의에 참석했다.)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik Returns Home After Completing Qatar Condolence Mission (강훈식, 카타르 조문특사 일정 마치고 귀국)
item.description:
Kang Hoon-sik Returns Home After Completing Qatar Condolence Mission (강훈식, 카타르 조문특사 일정 마치고 귀국)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik returned home on the 16th after completing his mission as a special envoy to convey condolences to former Qatari Emir Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. <<> According to the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae, Chief Kang arrived back in the afternoon of the 16th after paying respects to Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, the former monarch of Qatar, who passed away on the 12th. Kang attended the condolence ceremony at the Lusail Palace in Qatar on the 15th local time and conveyed President Lee Jae-myung’s heartfelt condolences to King Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani. <<> Cheong Wa Dae reported that King Tamim expressed gratitude to the South Korean government for dispatching a high-level condolence delegation during a difficult time, noting that this would help elevate bilateral relations to a higher level. <<> Chief Kang also held discussions with Qatar’s Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, and Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defense Affairs, Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani. During these meetings, Kang assessed that the legacy of the former emir, symbolized by the 'Qatar National Vision 2030,' had laid the groundwork for the establishment of a comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries in 2023. He also expressed hope for expanding the horizons of cooperation based on the trust between the two nations’ leaders. <<> Upon arriving at the airport, Kang met with reporters and explained, “The people in Qatar were also concerned about the situation in the Middle East. We conveyed South Korea’s commitment to deep solidarity with Qatar and promised to further strengthen our cooperative relationship until the conflict in the Middle East ends.” <<> Earlier, President Lee sent a condolence message regarding the passing of former emir Hamad. It was reported that during the government’s consultations on sending a condolence envoy, Qatar specifically requested Chief Kang for the mission. Kang had previously visited Qatar in April as a special envoy for strategic economic cooperation, meeting with King Tamim to discuss energy supply chains and economic collaboration plans. (강훈식 대통령 비서실장이 카타르 하마드 빈 칼리파 알 싸니 부왕 조문특사 일정을 마치고 16일 귀국했다.)

item.title: The Full Story Behind the Desertion Allegations Against Ahn Gyu-baek: "Did the Blue House and the Democratic Party Know and Cover It Up?" [Black and White Yeouido] (안규백 탈영 의혹의 전말 “청와대·민주당, 알고도 뭉갰나” [흑백여의도])
item.description:
The Full Story Behind the Desertion Allegations Against Ahn Gyu-baek: "Did the Blue House and the Democratic Party Know and Cover It Up?" [Black and White Yeouido] (안규백 탈영 의혹의 전말 “청와대·민주당, 알고도 뭉갰나” [흑백여의도])

The police have launched an investigation into allegations that Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek deserted his military duties and gave false testimony before the National Assembly. On the 16th, the Seoul Yongsan Police Station questioned Kim Young-soo, the director of the Public Interest Reporting Center for a Transparent Society, as the complainant who had reported Minister Ahn for violating the National Assembly Testimony and Appraisal Act. Director Kim claims that while serving as a home guard, Minister Ahn deserted his duties (went AWOL) for approximately seven months, was detained for about 30 days as a result, and that "detention for 30 days" is recorded in his military records. He also stated that because of this, Ahn served a total of 22 months, eight months longer than the standard 14-month home guard service period at the time. In response, Minister Ahn and the Ministry of National Defense have refuted this, stating, "He completed his service normally, and the alleged desertion is clearly false." The Chosun Ilbo's YouTube channel 'Black and White Yeouido' compiled a comprehensive summary of the allegations against Minister Ahn. (경찰이 안규백 국방 장관 군무 이탈 의혹 및 국회 허위 증언에 대한 수사에 착수했다. 서울 용산경찰서는 안 장관을 국회증언감정법 위반 혐의로 고발한 청렴사회를 위한 공익신고센터 김영수 센터장을 16일 고발인 신분으로 조사했다. 김 센터장은 안 장관이 방위병으로 복무 중 약 7개월간 군무 이탈(탈영)을 했고, 이로 인해 약 30일간 구금돼 병적 기록에 ‘구금 30일’이 명시돼 있다고 주장하고 있다. 또 이 때문에 당시 방위 복무 기간(14개월)보다 8개월 추가된 22개월 복무를 했다고 밝혔다. 이에 대해 안 장관과 국방부는 “정상적으로 복무를 완료했고, 해당 (군무 이탈) 의혹은 명백한 허위”라고 반박했다. 조선일보 유튜브 ‘흑백여의도’는 안 장관 군무 이탈 의혹을 총정리해 봤다.)

― Who is Director Kim Young-soo, who reported Minister Ahn? (―안규백 장관을 고발한 김영수 센터장은 누구인가.)

"Director Kim Young-soo received the Order of National Security Merit (Sam-il Medal) for his contributions in an internal whistleblowing case regarding military supply corruption at Gyeryongdae while serving as a Navy Lieutenant Commander. This case was even turned into a movie titled 'Top Secret.' After his discharge, he worked as an investigator in the defense sector at the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission and as the head of the Investigation Division 2 at the Military Accident Investigation Committee under the President." (“김영수 센터장은 해군 소령 복무 당시 계룡대 군납 비리 내부 공익 제보 사건에 대한 공로를 인정받아 보국훈장(삼일장)을 받았다. 이 사건이 ‘1급 기밀’이라는 제목으로 영화화되기도 했다. 전역 후 국민권익위원회 국방분야조사관, 대통령 소속 군사망사고조사위원회 조사2과장으로 근무했다.”)

― What was the reason for filing the complaint? (―고발장을 낸 이유는.)

"The title of the complaint is 'False Testimony at the National Assembly's Confirmation Hearing for the Minister of National Defense Candidate Regarding a Significant Period of Intentional Desertion During Home Guard Service.' So, according to Director Kim's claim, Minister Ahn Gyu-baek deserted his duties (went AWOL) while serving as a home guard, and then gave false testimony about this fact during his confirmation hearing." (“고발장 제목은 ‘국회 국방부장관 후보자 인사청문회 시 “방위병 복무 중 상당 기간의 고의적인 군무 이탈 사실”에 대한 허위 증언’이다. 그러니까 김 센터장 주장에 따르면, 안규백 장관이 방위병으로 군 복무를 할 때 군무 이탈(탈영)을 했는데, 인사청문회에서 이 같은 사실에 대해 거짓 증언을 했다는 것이다.”)

― What kind of false testimony did Minister Ahn allegedly give? (―안 장관이 어떤 거짓 증언을 했다는 건가.)

"According to records, Minister Ahn served as a home guard in Daesan-myeon, Gochang-gun, North Jeolla Province, his hometown, for 22 months from November 5, 1983, to August 31, 1985. However, the standard home guard service period at the time was 14 months. If he had served normally, his service should have been from November 5, 1983, to January 4, 1985. But the military service records show his service period was eight months (240 days) longer. (“안 장관은 1983년 11월5일부터 1985년 8월31일까지 22개월 동안 자신의 고향인 전라북도 고창군 대산면에서 방위병으로 군 복무를 했다고 기록돼 있다. 그런데 당시 방위병 복무 기간은 14개월이었다. 정상적으로 군 복무했다면 1983년 11월 5일부터 1985년 1월4일까지여야 하는데, 병무 기록상 복무 기간이 그보다 8개월(240일) 더 길었던 것이다.)

Minister Ahn claims that his discharge on January 4th was correct. His explanation is that 'his mother provided lunch to the unit for about two to three weeks, and a complaint related to this was sent to higher authorities. He was summoned for questioning by the Military Security Command (now Defense Security Command) or the Military Police three or four times. The unit contacted him saying that the three days of investigation were not included in his service period, so he served an additional three days during vacation, which led to the error in the recorded service period.' Director Kim Young-soo claims precisely this part is a lie. (안 장관은 1월4일 소집 해제된 게 맞다고 주장한다. ‘당시 안 장관 어머니가 약 2~3주간 부대에 점심을 제공했는데 이와 관련해 상부에 투서가 올라갔고 기무사 또는 헌병대에 서너 차례 불려가 조사를 받았다. 그 조사 기간 3일이 복무기간에 포함되지 않았다고 부대에서 연락이 와서 방학 때 3일 더 군복무를 했는데, 이 때문에 복무 기간이 잘못 기재돼 있다’는 것이다. 김영수 센터장은 바로 이 부분이 거짓말이라고 주장한다.)

Director Kim asserts, "While serving as a home guard, Minister Ahn deserted his duties (went AWOL) for about seven months, was detained for approximately 30 days as a result, and his military records state 'detention for 30 days'." He also stated, "Because of this, he served an extra eight months beyond the original home guard service period (14 months)." (김 센터장은 “안 장관이 방위병으로 복무 중 약 7개월 간 군무이탈(탈영)을 했고, 이로 인해 약 30일간 구금돼 병적기록에 ‘구금 30일’이 있다”고 주장한다. 또 “이 때문에 원래 방위 복무기간(14개월)보다 8개월 추가 복무를 했다”고 밝혔다.”)

― As Minister Ahn claims, if he needed to serve a few more days, can his discharge be cancelled and he be re-enlisted? (―안규백 장관 주장대로 며칠 더 복무해야 한다고 해서, 전역을 취소하고 재입대할 수 있나.)

"According to the Military Service Act, once a soldier is discharged, they become a reserve. Director Kim Young-soo claims that at that time, there were absolutely no laws, related regulations, or procedures that allowed for a reserve's status to be converted back to active duty to serve a remaining period at their former unit. Furthermore, Director Kim stated that even if the discharge was granted before fulfilling the mandatory service days, it would be an administrative error by the assigned unit, not Minister Ahn's responsibility, so there would be no reason for him to serve again." (“병역법에 따르면, 소집해제(전역)가 되면 예비역이 된다. 예비역이 된 이후 다시 현역으로 신분이 전환돼, 복무했던 부대에서 잔여 기간을 추가로 복무토록 하는 법령 및 관련 규정과 절차는 그 당시 전혀 없었다고 김영수 센터장은 주장한다. 또 의무 복무 일수가 미달된 상태에서 소집해제가 됐다고 해도 이는 소속 부대 행정업무 착오이고 안규백 장관 책임은 아니기 때문에 다시 복무할 이유가 없다고 김 센터장은 밝혔다.”)

― Minister Ahn could easily resolve this by releasing his military records. (―안 장관이 병적 자료를 공개하면 깨끗이 해결될 일인데.)

"Minister Ahn continues to refuse to release them. Explaining why, Minister Ahn stated during his confirmation hearing, 'I have lived my life without a single stain. The military records currently maintained do not match the reality. In a way, I could be seen as a victim of military administration. As the Minister of National Defense, who oversees military affairs and command, this is not something I can disclose lightly.'" (“안 장관은 이를 계속 공개하지 않고 있다. 그 이유에 대해 안 장관은 인사청문회에서 “저는 한 점 부끄럼 없이 세상을 살았습니다. 현재 관리되고 있는 이 병적 기록상에는 실제와 다르게 돼 있습니다. 사실 어찌 보면 병무 행정의 피해자라고 볼 수 있습니다. 군정과 군령을 관장하는 국방부 장관으로서 섣불리 공개할 수가 없는 내용입니다”라고 했다.”)

― If the records are incorrect, can't they be corrected? (―사실과 다르게 기재돼 있다면 병적 기록을 수정하면 되지 않나.)

"Minister Ahn has stated that he first saw that his military records differed from reality when he ran for the National Assembly for the third time (in 2016). He could have corrected them then, but has yet to request a correction. A Ministry of National Defense official stated, 'Releasing a record that has been erroneous for 40 years could fuel misunderstanding. Minister Ahn plans to take steps to correct the military records after he leaves office.'" (“안규백 장관은 병적기록이 실제와 다르게 돼 있다는 걸 3번째 국회의원 출마할 때(2016년) 처음 봤다고 밝혔다. 안 장관은 그때 바꿀 수 있었지만 아직 수정 요구를 하지 않았다. 국방부 관계자는 “40년 전 잘못된 기록을 공개하면 오해를 키울 수 있다. 안 장관이 퇴임한 후 병적 기록 정정 조치를 하겠다”고 밝혔다.”)

― Is there a possibility the original military records have been lost or damaged? (―병적자료 원본이 사라졌거나 훼손됐을 가능성은 없나.)

"Military records are 'permanent preservation' documents. Before computers were introduced to the military, most records were kept manually. It is said that these manually written records are continuously preserved through the military's digitization (PDF) process." (“병적 자료는 ‘영구보존’ 문서이다. 컴퓨터가 군에 도입되기 이전까지는 대부분 수기로 기재해 보관했고, 수기로 기재한 병적 자료는 군의 파일화(PDF) 작업을 통해 계속 보존한다고 한다.”)

― Did Minister Ahn provide any other evidence besides the military records? (―안 장관은 병적 자료 외에 다른 근거를 제시했나.)

"Instead of military records, Minister Ahn released his academic records. These show that he attended the first semester of his third year after his discharge on January 4, 1985. He also reportedly has the transcript for that semester. Director Kim questions why he releases academic records instead of just providing the military records to clear up the suspicions completely." (“안 장관은 병적 자료 대신 학적기록부를 공개했다. 여기에는 안 장관이 1985년 1월 4일 소집 해제 이후 3학년 1학기를 다닌 것으로 나와 있다. 또 3학년 1학기 대학 성적표도 있다고 한다. 이에 대해 의혹을 말끔히 해소하려면 병적 자료만 내놓으면 되는데 왜 학적 기록을 공개하냐고 김 센터장은 주장한다.”)

― So what evidence is Director Kim Young-soo presenting? (―그렇다면 김영수 센터장은 어떤 근거를 내세우고 있나.)

"It is known that Director Kim did not personally see Minister Ahn's military records. However, according to the complaint, about two weeks before Minister Ahn's confirmation hearing (July 15, 2025), Director Kim received a call from a contact in the Democratic Party at the National Assembly, whom he knew personally. The Democratic Party contact reportedly asked Director Kim, 'Ahn Gyu-baek's military records say "detention (30 days)," but the specific reason for the detention isn't listed. Under what circumstances would a home guard in 1985 receive a 30-day detention?' Director Kim's side claims it is certain that the Democratic Party associate was looking directly at the military records while asking him these questions. (“김 센터장이 직접 안 장관의 병적자료를 본 건 아닌 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 고발장에 따르면, 안 장관 인사청문회(2025년 7월15일)를 약 2주 앞두고 김 센터장은 평소 친분이 있던 국회 민주당 관계자로부터 전화를 받았다고 한다. 민주당 관계자는 김 센터장에게 “안규백 병적 자료에 ‘구금(30일)’이라고 기재돼 있는데, 구금의 구체적인 사유는 기재돼 있지 않다. 1985년 당시 방위병이 어떤 경우에 구금 30일 처분이 되는지” 물었다고 한다. 당시 민주당 관계자는 병적자료를 직접 보면서 김 센터장에게 질문을 한 게 확실하다는 게 김 센터장 측 주장이다.)

Furthermore, according to the complaint, Director Kim heard from a certain government official that 'Blue House officials also checked the Defense Minister candidate's military records and were quite concerned about the fact that "detention (30 days)" was listed. They were considering whether to withdraw the nomination if the reason for this 30-day detention was a prolonged, intentional desertion due to external influence.' The official also reportedly said, 'The fact that the Defense Minister candidate's military records contain "detention (30 days)" is also known to some ruling party lawmakers' offices.' It is presumed that Director Kim recorded these phone conversations on his smartphone. (또 고발장에 따르면 김 센터장은 모 정부관계자로부터 “청와대 관계자도 국방부장관 후보자의 병적자료를 확인했고, 병적자료에 ‘구금(30일)’이라고 기재돼 있는 사실로 인해 상당한 우려를 하고 있다. 만약 위 구금(30일)의 사유가 어떤 외부적인 영향력에 의한 고의적인 장기간의 군무이탈(탈영)로 인한 것이라면 후보지명을 철회해야 하는 것까지 고민하고 있다” “국방부장관 후보자에 대한 구금(30일)이 병적자료에 기재돼 있다는 사실은 일부 여당 국회의원실에서도 인지하고 있다”는 내용을 들었다고 한다. 김 센터장은 이같은 통화내용을 자신의 스마트폰에 녹음했을 것으로 추정된다.)

In summary, while Director Kim did not personally view Minister Ahn's military records, he claims that through various channels he has confirmed that 'detention (30 days)' is clearly written in them, and that circumstantial evidence strongly suggests the reason for the 30-day detention was desertion." (정리하면 김 센터장이 직접 안 장관 병적자료를 본 건 아니지만 여러 경로를 통해 확인한 결과 안 장관 병적자료에 구금(30일)이라고 적힌 게 분명하고, 정황상 구금(30일) 이유는 군무이탈이 확실하다는 것이다.”)

― So, was the Blue House and the ruling party also aware of the 30-day detention of Minister Ahn Gyu-baek before his appointment? (―청와대 및 여당 측도 안규백 장관에 대한 구금(30일) 사실을 임명 이전에 알고 있었다는 얘긴가.)

"Yes, according to the complaint. Even for a non-Defense Minister candidate, if the candidate is male, it is standard procedure for the Blue House to check their military records. (“고발장에 따르면 그렇다. 국방장관이 아니라고 해도 장관 후보자가 남성일 경우 청와대가 해당 인사에 대한 병적자료를 확인하는 건 기본이다.)

A report in the Ilgan Sports newspaper on the 15th also contains this information. During a phone call between Director Kim Young-soo and a government official, the government official reportedly said, 'The cause of the detention has been confirmed as desertion' and 'I heard they wouldn't proceed with the appointment.' Furthermore, it is reported that after the confirmation hearing, a Ministry of National Defense official conveyed to Director Kim that 'Minister Ahn was grateful that you didn't make it public.'" (15일자 일요신문 보도에는 이런 내용도 나온다. 김영수 센터장과 정부관계자가 전화 통화를 했는데 정부관계자가 “구금 원인을 군무이탈로 확인을 했다” “(안 장관) 인사를 하지 않을 것이란 이야기를 들었다”고 말했다고 한다. 또 인사청문회 후엔 국방부 관계자가 김 센터장에게 “공개하지 않아줘서 안 장관이 고마워하더라”는 입장을 밝힌 것으로 알려졌다.”)

― But if 'detention (30 days)' is in the military records, shouldn't the reason also be recorded? (―그런데 병적자료에 ‘구금(30일)’이라고 돼 있다면 그 이유도 기록돼 있어야 하는 것 아닌가.)

"Director Kim said it is strange that, according to regulations, the reason for the 30-day detention should be clearly recorded, but it isn't. He also pointed out that if someone deserted for seven months, the Military Criminal Act would prescribe imprisonment of one year or more (there is no suspended sentence for desertion), yet Minister Ahn did not receive such a sentence, which is also odd. (“김 센터장은 규정대로라면 구금(30일)에 대한 이유가 명확히 기록돼 있어야 하는데 그게 없는 게 의아하다고 했다. 또 만약 군무이탈을 7개월 했다면 군형법에 따라 1년 이상의 징역(군무이탈은 집행유예가 없음)에 처해야 하는데 안 장관이 그런 처분을 받지 않은 것도 이상한 부분이라고 했다.)

In connection with this, according to information Director Kim gathered from acquaintances of Minister Ahn, Minister Ahn's family was wealthy in the Daesan-myeon area, and his father wielded considerable influence. So, Director Kim's claim is that Minister Ahn's family used their influence, resulting in the unavoidable record of a 30-day detention while avoiding prison time." (이와 관련해 김 센터장이 안 장관 주변 지인에게 확인한 바에 따르면, 안 장관 집안은 대산면 일대에서 재력이 있었고, 부친의 영향력도 상당했다고 한다. 그러니까 안 장관 집안이 영향력을 행사해서 구금(30일) 기록은 어쩔 수 없이 남지만 징역은 피하게 만든 것 아니냐는 게 김 센터장의 주장이다.”)

― Did Director Kim present any other evidence? (―김 센터장이 또 다른 근거를 제시했나.)

"According to the complaint, Director Kim Young-soo personally met with acquaintances of Minister Ahn in his hometown and secured testimony. According to these testimonies, Minister Ahn was a student at Sungkyunkwan University at the time. The Daesan-myeon unit commander allegedly gave Minister Ahn special privileges, effectively allowing him to not show up for duty for several months, a fact that was widely known among the residents of Daesan-myeon at the time. Director Kim reportedly heard that 'In the latter half of 1984, the Daesan-myeon police station chief or some residents or fellow home guards reported this fact to the assigned unit's military police or military security unit. Consequently, the unit's military police arrested and detained the accused.'" <<>― Is there any other documentation in the military besides the military records that could resolve the suspicions about Minister Ahn?<<>> "Yes. Since call-up and discharge orders are military personnel orders, they are all preserved as records. The personnel orders for Minister Ahn Gyu-baek would likely be kept at the Gyeryongdae Army Records Information Management Unit." (“고발장에 따르면, 김영수 센터장은 직접 안규백 장관의 고향 지인들을 만나 증언을 확보했다고 한다. 고향 지인 증언에 따르면 안 장관이 당시 성균관대학교 재학 중이었다고 한다. 대산면중대장은 어떤 이유로 안규백 장관이 수개월 간의 복무 중 사실상 출근하지 않아도 되는 특혜를 줬으며, 이러한 사실이 그 당시 대산면 상당의 주민들도 인지하고 있었다는 것이다. ‘1984년 후반기 대산면 파출소장 또는 어느 주민이나 방위병 등에 의해서 이러한 사실이 소속부대 헌병대 또는 기무부대에 알려지게 되었고, 이에 소속부대 헌병대는 피고발인을 체포해 구금하게 됐다’는 얘기를 김 센터장이 들었다고 한다.”)

― If Director Kim Young-soo's claims are clearly false, couldn't Minister Ahn Gyu-baek sue him for defamation? (―병적자료 말고 안 장관 의혹을 해소할 수 있는 다른 자료는 군에 없나.)

"Minister Ahn has not taken any action, such as filing a lawsuit, against Director Kim Young-soo, who raised the allegations, which is fueling the suspicions." (“있다. 소집 및 소집해제는 군 인사명령에 해당되기 때문에 모두 기록으로 보존한다. 안규백 장관의 인사명령은 계룡대 육군 기록정보관리단에 보관돼 있을 것이다.”)

-What is the position of the Blue House and the Democratic Party? (―김영수 센터장 주장이 명백한 허위라면, 안규백 장관이 김 센터장을 명예훼손으로 고소하면 되지 않나.)

"The Blue House has not issued any official statement. President Lee Jae-myung, while presiding over a cabinet meeting on the 14th, did not mention the desertion allegations against Minister Ahn or the opposition party's offensive. Previously, when Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young's mention of North Korea's nuclear facilities in Yongbyon led to the U.S. restricting the sharing of North Korea-related intelligence, President Lee quickly defended Minister Jeong. (“안 장관은 의혹을 제기한 김영수 센터장에게 고소 등 어떤 조치도 취하지 않고 있어서 의혹을 키우고 있다.”)

Furthermore, the Democratic Party has also not shown any movement to protect Minister Ahn. In political circles, there is talk that Minister Ahn will be replaced in an upcoming cabinet reshuffle. The People Power Party has stated that if the military records are not disclosed, it will move to impeach Minister Ahn Gyu-baek." (-청와대와 민주당 입장은.)

item.title: President Lee follows Kim Bo-mi’s X account targeting the 86-generation within a day of its creation (李 대통령, 86세대 직격한 김보미 X 개설 하루만에 팔로우)
item.description:
President Lee follows Kim Bo-mi’s X account targeting the 86-generation within a day of its creation (李 대통령, 86세대 직격한 김보미 X 개설 하루만에 팔로우)

President Lee Jae-myung followed the X (formerly Twitter) account of Kim Bo-mi, a 36-year-old former chairwoman of the Gangjin County Council in South Jeolla Province who is running in the Democratic Party of Korea’s leadership election, within a day of its creation. Former Chairwoman Kim directly targeted the party’s mainstream 86-generation during her policy address on the 12th. She sparked controversy by saying, “In the age of AI, the 586-generation—those who once wielded Molotov cocktails and rocks—are still the mainstay of the Democratic Party.” (이재명 대통령이 더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 36세의 김보미 전 전남 강진군의회 의장의 엑스(옛 트위터) 계정을 개설 하루 만에 팔로우했다. 김 전 의장은 지난 12일 정견 발표 당시 민주당 주류인 86세대를 직격했다. 당시 “AI 시대에 화염병, 짱돌 들던 586세대가 아직도 (민주당의) 주축”이라고 해 화제가 됐다.)

Former Chairwoman Kim opened her X account on the 12th. President Lee followed the account the very next day, on the 13th. (김 전 의장은 지난 12일 X 계정을 개설했다. 이 대통령이 해당 계정을 팔로우한 건 바로 다음 날인 13일이었다.)

During her policy address, former Chairwoman Kim stated, “The pro-democracy movement should be respected, but that cannot grant the right to monopolize politics for 40 to 50 years.” She added, “In a country that should aim to become one of the three major powers in AI, should the generation that once wielded Molotov cocktails and rocks still be the mainstay?” With former Prime Minister Kim, former Representative Jeong, and Assemblymember Song—key figures of the 86-generation—present before her, she effectively called for their voluntary retirement. Former Chairwoman Kim also said, “The Democratic Party is a ‘five-none’ party, where fairness, democracy, generational change, youth, and the future have all vanished,” adding, “Because there is no fairness or democracy within the party, young people are leaving.” (김 전 의장은 정견 발표 때 “민주화운동은 존중받아야 하지만, 그것이 40~50년 정치를 독점할 권리가 될 수는 없다”며 “AI(인공지능) 3대 강국을 향해야 할 나라에서 화염병과 짱돌을 들던 세대가 아직도 주축이어야 하느냐”고 했다. 86세대 핵심인 김 전 총리, 정 전 대표, 송 의원을 앞에 두고 사실상 용퇴를 주장한 것이다. 김 전 의장은 “민주당은 공정·민주·세대교체·청년·미래가 모두 사라진 ‘5무(無) 정당’이라며 “당내에 공정도, 민주주의도 없기 때문에 청년이 떠나는 것”이라고도 했다.)

In particular, targeting former Representative Jeong, she remarked, “No one takes responsibility for young people leaving the Democratic Party; they only look out for their own interests, and the person who should be accountable is running again for one more term.” The YouTube video containing these remarks has garnered over 1.19 million views. (특히 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “청년이 민주당을 떠나는데 책임지는 사람은 없고 밥그릇만 챙기겠다며 책임져야 할 사람이 한 번 더 하겠다고 나왔다”고도 했다. 이 발언을 담은 유튜브 영상은 조회 수 119만회가 넘었다.)

In a broadcast interview that day, former Chairwoman Kim said, “Even if it’s like throwing an egg against a rock, the high-ranking figures, no matter how stubborn they are, are dead set on clinging to power. Today, I challenged the massive rock of vested interests to convey the grassroots sentiment on the ground.” She added, “The Democratic Party, having lost fairness, has also lost its youth, and without youth, the Democratic Party has no future.” <<>> (김 전 의장은 이날 방송 인터뷰에선 “계란으로 바위 치기라고 해도 높으신 분들은 죽었다 깨어나도 바닥 민심을 전하기 위해서 거대한 기득권의 바위에 오늘 도전을 했다”며 “공정을 잃은 민주당은 청년을 잃었고 청년을 잃은 민주당의 미래는 없다”라고도 했다.)
